decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the bushing clearance and piston-rod guidance clauses; the piston-end arrangement change requires no additional candidate-state change.
Changing which portion of the piston occupies the sliding part does not change the established premachining, welding, and final-machining sequence for POS 1, POS 2, and POS 3.
The source does not change any current main-shaft stock, diameter, keyway, locking-thread, or bushing-space geometry attribute.
The corrected piston-end arrangement does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source changes mechanical arrangement and guidance details but does not change any material specification.
The broad drawing-set deliverable remains required unchanged, while the target-specific drawing correction is already represented by the source Requirement.
The source supplies a design correction but does not change the requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model.
The piston-end arrangement has no effect on the applicable ČSN/EN standards or drawing-template policy.
The source corrects a modeled mechanical arrangement but does not necessarily change the independent requirement concerning technical dimensions and annotations.
